title: 커버드콜의 올바른 활용 — 옵션 매도·분배율·하락 위험

source_audit.limitations: Options quotes and ETF sample-level 2025 payout statistics are not reproduced; private actual order book/option execution and original audio/frames not checked.
source_audit.evidence_reference: 685 Korean SRT cues read and indexed; 20 material option payoffs, covered-call income, NAV/return-of-capital and trade examples tied to original timecodes; verified against OIC Options Education, Cboe index strategy and SEC fund distribution bulletins.
